title: Filinvest, Infosys BPM extend 12-year office partnership

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filinvest Land Inc. (FLI) is extending its 12-year partnership with Infosys BPM as the global IT-BPM company consolidates its Alabang operations in a larger office spanning more than 10,000 square meters (sq m). In a statement, the Gotianun-led property developer said Infosys BPM would occupy five floors at Axis Tower Two in Northgate Cyberzone, Filinvest City, Muntinlupa. READ: Filinvest Land bucks slump with 4% profit growth Moreover, the transaction, through FLI’s office leasing arm Filinvest Cyberparks Inc., also provides for an eventual expansion involving more than 1,000 sq m of additional leased space.
